title: Oracle, an assistant that reads your editor, and a nudge when the query lands
notes: Oracle is the fourth engine. No Instant Client, no ORACLE_HOME, nothing to install — the driver runs in Thin mode and talks to the database directly. Oracle 12.1 or newer, and the connection asks for a service name rather than a database, because it's the one engine whose databases can't be listed

Ask AI can read the query already open in the tab, so "what does this do?" and "group this by month" work on what you've written. Select part of it first and it sees only that fragment — and only that fragment is replaced when you insert the answer. Cmd+Z undoes either

Downpick tells you when a long query finishes — a system notification if you've switched away, an in-app one if you haven't, never both. Off after a threshold you set, ten seconds by default, and never for a query you cancelled
Query ▸ Run Statement (F9) runs just the statement under the cursor, without selecting it first
Choose where the vault lives from a file dialog — on first launch, or later in Settings. Browse… opens one you already have, New location… places a new one
Menu items that need an unlocked vault are greyed out while it's locked, so their shortcuts no longer fire into a screen that isn't there

title: Conversations that keep, and queries you can watch
notes: Ask AI conversations are saved. Every tab keeps its own, and the history button lists every past chat — pick one back up, or clear them all
A running query now shows a live timer and a cancel button instead of an empty grid
New Messages view for statements that return no rows — one line per statement, with the rows each one affected
Refresh a connection's database list without disconnecting it
The Ask AI box grows with your question rather than scrolling inside two lines
Fixed: macOS no longer reports the app as damaged on first launch, and the dock icon is correct

title: First release
notes: PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and MongoDB, connected at the same time
Schema explorer down to columns and collection fields
Ask AI writes queries from your schema — read-only, never executes
Copy as table, export to CSV or Excel
